The median duration of response was 12.5 months (95% CI 8.4, 23.7), indicating that the responses were durable.

citations.quote: The updated indication based on this sNDA has been expanded "for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) whose tumors are anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive as detected by an FDA-approved test." changes.note: Added a verbatim citation from MultidisciplineR L48 that supports the crizotinib-resistance mutation claim (EML4-ALK v1L1196M and EML4-ALK v1G1202R associated with resistance to crizotinib); the claim was already true, only lacked a supporting citation.

Changed 'Serious adverse reactions occurred in 32% of patients' to 'in 32% of the 295 patients' to match the label L111 verbatim wording and resolve the 295-vs-332 inconsistency; replaced the fragmentary serious/fatal quotes with the single full verbatim L111 sentence covering both 32% and 2.7%.

Added the Warnings & Precautions summary from label L105 as a verbatim citation supporting the enumerated key risks (hepatotoxicity, CNS effects, hyperlipidemia, atrioventricular block, ILD/pneumonitis); changed 'AV block' to 'atrioventricular block' to match the source wording.

Corrected the CFR wording to 'accelerated approval according to 21 CFR 314.510 Subpart H' to match its own verbatim citation from MultidisciplineR L50; the review states 314.510 Subpart H (the 314.500 form appears only in the approval letter for a different field).
